title: Juana de Ibarbourou's birth chart
metaDescription: Juana de Ibarbourou's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 18.6° Pisces. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Moon stands at 23.2° Cancer, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 18.6° Pisces: the second decan, whose classical sub-ruler is the Moon. A water sign, read here in its second face.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Mercury holds 20.8° Pisces, Venus holds 28.2° Aries, Mars holds 27.0° Sagittarius — in the old shorthand, a mind that absorbs before it argues; taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate; drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Mars to Saturn is the closest call of the day, a square within 0.5°. Nothing in a square flows; everything in it works. The old texts kept squares for the charts they respected. Behind it, Neptune conjunction Pluto at 0.5°, and Jupiter opposition Saturn at 0.6° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Mercury opposes Saturn while both square Mars. The t-square is the figure the old texts trusted for output: friction with a fixed address. Uranus stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has four entries for this chart. The Moon in Cancer at 23.2° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mercury in Pisces at 20.8° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Aries at 28.2° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Pisces at 28.0° is in domicile. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements water 5, fire 2, air 2, earth 1; modalities mutable 7, cardinal 2, fixed 1. Water signs hold memory in the scheme, where nothing is quite finished and little is genuinely forgotten. Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Cancer for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.8° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 23.2°.
